vscodevim.documented: VSCodeVim 1.32.4 motion.ts L1380-L1421 distinguishes G (LineWise) from C-End (CharacterWise). TextObject L27-L37/L436-L452 gives is an EOF stop without changing register mode; IndentObjectMatch L597-L672 gives ii the next line start; ip L519-L553 ends at the last nonempty line EOL and sets LineWise. modeHandler.ts L1064-L1100 clamps EOF and decreases CharacterWise endpoints. ChangeOperator L666-L682 uses getRight (position.ts L313-L318 clamps at EOL); YankOperator L209-L255 reads an API-clamped range and retains the movement's end column for a Normal linewise yank. Thus c/y C-End and cis/yis exclude the final newline, yii contains only line1, yip ends at [0,20], while cG retains a LineWise final newline. Scoped to seven exact no-setup rows in the fixed four-line fixture; named/count/Visual variants are excluded.
